train_lightweight_gan: train a LightweightGAN model using the Trainer class with a HuggingFace dataset and configurable hyperparameters
generate_images_gan: generate images from a trained LightweightGAN using the Trainer generate method with default or EMA variants
calculate_fid_score: calculate the FID score for a trained GAN by comparing generated images against real dataset images
create_generator_discriminator: create a Generator and Discriminator network for the LightweightGAN with configurable attention layers and frequency channel attention
save_load_gan_checkpoint: save and load LightweightGAN model checkpoints using the Trainer save and load methods for resuming training
